kind: controlled contract tests; native SDK/network mocked, no Play account or paid ad requests

tests.name: five products: verify -> atomic delivery -> finish/consume/ack; localized prices
cancel, error, pending and invalid receipt give no goods
storage failure: no delivery and no consume; restore retries safely
finish failure: retry acknowledges without double gold
clean save restore permanent products; consumed gold never restored; refund revokes
missing validator: order disabled; local ownership cannot authorize purchases
UMP blocks all ad loads until form completed; NPA only; privacy entry
denied/unavailable consent: no SDK init or load; denial with canRequestAds uses NPA
first 3 completed runs: 0 interstitial; boundary 179999/180000ms; clock rollback; remove_ads
reward granted once only on Rewarded event; dismissal alone gives zero; optional after remove_ads
active play / menu / stale run: never display; concurrent reward serialized
server verifies Play state/product/test flag and strips token; pending/refund/mismatch/network
test defaults ignore real IDs; production rejects missing config; secrets never exported
